fields.source_ref: the capstone prompt (W2 publishes the inputs); spec docs/graded-field-audit/w2/nodal.json
fields.recommendation: Amend the two prompts to state the constants (no graded value moves). Without that the six Expert fields and four Professional fields cannot be obtained by any route the course offers.
fields.evidence: W2: Prompt only, no field moves. The prompt called the tubing curve "the gravity-plus-friction relation supplied with this capstone" and never stated its constants (3835, 600, 0.000238 lived only in nodalLab.js CAP), nor where the 49 points start (B5 finding 1). The prompt now states the relation, the wellhead pressure and the sampling, and restates the inflow the open flow comes from, so the four tubing fields are spreadsheet work on a form the course teaches (intermediate m03 l03). The two lift gas fields still need a Cullender and Smith march with the engine z; they stay class display for the W4 panel mode. The published inputs reproduce vlp_min_q_stbd = 1285.2338376891341 through the vendored engines against the key 1285.2338376891341 (tol 0.00064); src/lib/w2PublishedInputs.test.js re-runs it.

prompt_contains: The tubing curve is the gravity-plus-friction relation bhp(q) = pWh + 3835 / (1 + q/600) + 0.000238 q^2, with bhp and pWh in psia and q in stb/d, evaluated at a wellhead pressure of 1236 psia at 49 evenly spaced rates from one thousandth of the absolute open flow up to the absolute open flow itself. The open flow is the Associate tier's, from its composite inflow: reservoir pressure 3450 psia, bubble point 3100 psia and one test of 1200 stb/d at 2790 psia.

fields.source_ref: src/components/course/panels/nodal/VlpExplorer.jsx:595 (typedcolumn mode: the case typed as the prompt states it)
fields.evidence: HD (held decision, owner approved the lead recommendation 2026-09-22): a typed mode on VlpExplorer.jsx ("Your gas column, typed", typedGasColumn in nodalLab.js: one call to the vendored engine's cullenderSmithBhp on the typed tubing head pressure, gravity, measured and vertical depth, both temperatures and step count) takes the column the learner types. Typing the brief's column (0.72, 1225 psia, 8900 ft MD, 8300 ft TVD, 96 to 214 degF, 20 steps) prints the value at 6 dp within tol; yourCase.test.js proves it, that the BONNY-7 default and the panel's opening view land on no graded answer (D2 rules 1 to 3), and that the two station default or a vertical depth typed as the measured one misses.

shipped.prompt_append: On the course panel, the Outflow explorer's "Your gas column, typed" view takes this injection column as typed (gravity, tubing head pressure, both depths, both temperatures and the step count) and prints the pressures at the bottom of the column (the valve depth) and at its midpoint station to six decimals.

fields.source_ref: the capstone prompt (W2 publishes the inputs); spec docs/graded-field-audit/w2/nodal.json
fields.recommendation: Amend the two prompts to state the constants (no graded value moves). Without that the six Expert fields and four Professional fields cannot be obtained by any route the course offers.
fields.evidence: W2: Prompt only, no field moves. The node needs the tubing relation, which no prompt stated, and the grid needed its span: the prompt now states the Associate inflow, the Professional outflow with its constants, and that the 900 points only bracket each crossing, which is then solved exactly. Every field is then a spreadsheet root find (verified: the roots match the key to about 1e-6 stb/d). The published inputs reproduce node_op_q_stbd = 929.9820637311327 through the vendored engines against the key 929.9820637311327 (tol 0.00046); src/lib/w2PublishedInputs.test.js re-runs it.

prompt_contains: The inflow is the Associate tier's composite relation (reservoir pressure 3450 psia, bubble point 3100 psia and one test of 1200 stb/d at 2790 psia) and the outflow is the Professional tier's tubing relation bhp(q) = pWh + 3835 / (1 + q/600) + 0.000238 q^2 psia at a wellhead pressure of 1236 psia. Solve on a 900-point grid of rates evenly spaced from one thousandth to 0.999 of the absolute open flow: the grid only brackets each crossing, and a crossing is the exact rate at which the two pressures agree, with its flowing pressure read off the inflow.
